S1.why: Under the bracket a short adverbial label reads best; 'za darmo' is the everyday Polish for free, with no noun to inflect.

S2.why: Imperfective imperative in the ty form the vocabulary uses: an invitation to keep going, with no limit or sales word in it.

S3.s: Masz już komplet %lld darmowych cutlingów. Nadal nic nie kosztują i działają jak dotąd.
S3.back: You-have already full-set of-5 free cutlings. Still nothing not they-cost and they-work as until-now.
S3.why: 'Masz już komplet' says all are used without a gendered past tense (wykorzystałeś/aś); genitive plural 'cutlingów' fits 5; the second sentence gives both promises without repeating 'darmowe'.

S4.why: Perfective future in the ty form, the natural Polish for what you can do; avoids the 'Możesz…' that explains a control; genitive plural fits 5.

S5.why: 'z' takes the genitive plural for any number, so 'cutlingów' is right whatever the counts are; Polish keeps the English order, so plain %lld stays.

S6.why: 'Zmieścisz' talks about room the way a Pole would and fits 24 with Polish '5000' (CLDR does not group four digits); 'Miejsce na…' came out one over.

S7.s: Zapiszesz do %@ cutlingów tekstowych i %lld z obrazem.
S7.back: You-will-save up-to 5000 cutlings text and 500 with image.
S7.why: Uses the vocabulary's 'Cutling tekstowy' and 'Cutling z obrazem' so the two kinds keep their names; 'do' + genitive holds for any number; the second 'cutlingów' is dropped as a speaker would.

S8.why: Polish lists with a comma and 'i' before the last item, no serial comma; names stay in the nominative as in Apple's Polish headings.

S9.s: Jeden zakup wystarczy na wszystkie urządzenia z Twoim kontem Apple.
S9.back: One purchase suffices for all devices with Your account Apple.
S9.why: 'wystarczy na' is the idiom for one thing covering several; 'Twoim kontem Apple' follows the vocabulary's capitalised Twój and lower-case 'konto Apple'.

S10.why: A plain ty-form statement; 'tylko raz' says nothing recurs without the official-sounding 'jednorazowa płatność'.

S11.s: Bez subskrypcji, reklam i zakładania konta.
S11.back: Without subscription, advertisements and setting-up of-account.
S11.why: One 'bez' governs all three genitives, as Polish does; 'zakładanie konta' is the everyday phrase for signing up.

S12.why: The label Polish iOS apps use for the App Store restore action (checked on Polish app help pages); 'Odtwórz' is iOS's word for backups, not purchases.

S13.why: Verbal noun of the same verb as S12, ending in the ellipsis character, as Polish iOS shows work in progress.

S14.why: 'raz na zawsze' (once and for all) carries pay-once and keep-forever in one idiom; exactly 26 before the price.

S15.why: The same verb as S14 without the price, well inside 14.

S16.why: Puts the purchase off rather than refusing it, which is warmer than iOS's 'Nie teraz'.

S17.why: The imperative iOS Polish uses on close buttons.

S18.why: Short and a little proud; capital 'Twoje' as the vocabulary capitalises Twój; 19 characters.

S19.s: Dzięki za zakup. Wspierasz Cutling i jedyną osobę, która go tworzy.
S19.back: Thanks for purchase. You-support Cutling and the-only person, who it creates.
S19.why: Informal 'Dzięki' suits the ty voice; 'jedyną osobę' names the solo maker without gender; the name stays undeclined, as the inanimate accusative allows.

S20.s: Witaj z powrotem. Twój wcześniejszy zakup znów działa.
S20.back: Welcome with return. Your earlier purchase again works.
S20.why: 'Witaj z powrotem' is the standard Polish welcome back; present tense avoids a gendered past form.

S21.why: Same shape as S5 so VoiceOver and the screen agree; 'z' + genitive plural works for any count.

S22.why: The vocabulary's 'Cutlingów: %lld' pattern reads correctly for 1, 2, 5 and 21 without a plural rule; the noun after %@ is left out so 5000 needs no agreement.

S23.s: Odblokowano. Masz teraz miejsce na %@ cutlingów.
S23.back: Unlocked-impersonal. You-have now room for 5000 cutlings.
S23.why: Impersonal 'Odblokowano' has no gender and does not say 'Cutling', which a spoken voice cannot tell apart from the item word 'cutling'.

S24.why: The neutral Polish idiom for a transaction that did not complete; nobody is blamed.

S25.s: Nie można teraz połączyć się z App Store. Spróbuj ponownie za chwilę.
S25.back: Not possible now to-connect oneself with App Store. Try again in a-moment.
S25.why: Impersonal 'nie można' for the fault, ty imperative for the way out; App Store stays undeclined, as Apple's Polish does.

S26.s: App Store nie potwierdził tego zakupu.
S26.back: App Store not confirmed this purchase.
S26.why: Masculine past agrees with 'App Store' as Polish treats it; one plain fact.

S27.s: Na koncie Apple zalogowanym na tym urządzeniu nie ma zakupu w tej aplikacji.
S27.back: On account Apple logged-in on this device not is purchase in this application.
S27.why: 'zalogowanym' follows the vocabulary's 'zalogowanym do Twojego konta Apple'; 'tej aplikacji' avoids declining the name (Cutlinga) while making clear which purchase.

S28.s: Darmowa wersja mieści %lld cutlingów. Odblokuj Cutling raz, a zapiszesz ich, ile chcesz.
S28.back: Free version holds 5 cutlings. Unlock Cutling once, and you-will-save of-them, as-many-as you-want.
S28.why: 'mieści' fits a container; 'ile chcesz' is the spoken way to say as many as you like; the name sits in the inanimate accusative, which is the same as the nominative.

S29.why: Under the list title 'Cutlingi' the noun is understood; 'z' + genitive plural works for any count; 15 characters.

K1.why: Echoes S3's 'Masz już' with the noun left out, as a speaker would; 'Odblokuj tutaj' points at the capsule itself and fits 38 where 'Stuknij, by odblokować' did not.

M1.why: Verb-led imperative, as Polish Mac window and menu commands are; the name stays undeclined in the inanimate accusative.

M2.why: The same command as M1, with the ellipsis character because it opens a window.

M3.why: A noun phrase row label using the vocabulary's plural, lower case mid-label as in 'Twoje cutlingi'.

M4.why: The compact count pair Polish settings use; 'z' reads naturally after the label.

M5.why: Masculine participle agrees with the app's name; a status, so no verb.

M6.s: Jeden zakup odblokowuje Cutling na iPhonie, iPadzie i Macu.
M6.back: One purchase unlocks Cutling on iPhone, iPad and Mac.
M6.why: In running Polish prose the device names take the locative (na iPhonie, iPadzie, Macu), as Apple's Polish copy writes them; 'Cutling na Mac' stays the app's name elsewhere.

M7.s: Odblokowano na iPhonie, iPadzie i Macu zalogowanych do tego konta Apple.
M7.back: Unlocked-impersonal on iPhone, iPad and Mac logged-in to this account Apple.
M7.why: Impersonal past has no gender; 'zalogowanych do… konta Apple' is the vocabulary's wording.

M8.s: Masz Cutling z czasów, gdy był płatny, więc zostaje odblokowany. Dzięki za wsparcie.
M8.back: You-have Cutling from times, when it-was paid, so it-stays unlocked. Thanks for support.
M8.why: Says when it was bought without the gendered 'kupiłeś/kupiłaś'; 'Dzięki' matches S19.
